title: User Management
description: Full members + invites + roles-admin surface ported from superspace, props-driven + RBAC-agnostic. <UserManagementPanel> tabs Members + Roles: member table (search / filter / sort, inline role dropdown, soft-remove), InviteDialog + PendingInvites (resend / cancel), and a RolesPanel to create / edit / delete custom roles via a permission matrix (system roles read-only). All permission-gated. You pass `roles` + `currentPerms` + the permission catalog (resolved from rbac-roles) + CRUD/invite/role callbacks; the slice imports no other slice's frontend. Plus a TeamsPanel (named user groups) and tenant-hierarchy support: a generic um_tenant_links edge tree + propagating invites (InviteDialog gains a 'propagate to sub-workspaces' toggle with same / step-down role strategy). Convex ships um_members + um_invites + um_teams + um_team_members + um_tenant_links + member / invite / team / hierarchy endpoints (gated via rbac-roles' requirePermission); roles CRUD reuses rbac-roles'. rr never owns the tenant entities — only the tree edges. Plus an AccessMatrix (users × tenants grid, inline role assign) backed by getAccessMatrix. P0–P4c: the full superspace-parity user-management epic, complete.

peers.reason: Roles + resolved permissions + the convex permission helpers (requirePermission, getActorPermissions).
Member identity (name/email/avatar) joined from the users table.
